title: descriptioner
description: Lightweight Paper plugin that injects localized vanilla enchantment descriptions into item tooltips.
body:
# Descriptioner

Descriptioner is a lightweight Paper plugin that injects localized descriptions for all vanilla enchantments directly into item tooltips.

## Features
- Descriptions shown below each enchantment name in the item tooltip
- English and Spanish support — auto-detects the player's locale
- All descriptions are stored in editable YAML config files
- Silent fallback when a description is missing — no errors, no crashes
- Zero dependencies, minimal footprint

## Compatibility
- Paper / Purpur 1.21.4
- Java 21+
